title: 機械工学入門
subtitle: Introduction to Mechanical Engineering
keywords: Engineering 2.Mechanical Engineering 3.Mechanical Engineer 4.Self-Check 5.Leading Edge Research Projects
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) Learn the introduction to mechanical engineering. (2) Learn the relationship among the progress of industrial machine, academic area and leading edge research projects in department of mechanical engineering. (3) Set goals for own career design as engineers who have ningenryoku (in Japanese) and strength as innovators who can think and act for themselves after mastering data science.
advice: We will cover the following topics based on the student's self-check and self-analysis: ///// 1. To understand personal-advantages and setting goals for own career design as engineers who have ningenryoku (in Japanese) and strength as innovators who can think and act for themselves. 2. To understand the outline of mechanical engineering 3. To understand the mechanical engineer 4. To understand the overview of industrial machines 5. Introduction to leading edge research projects performed in department of mechanical engineering. ///// Students are required to actively participate in class. Students are expected to check for various messages and materials in class. Students should not be absent from class, as they may not receive the handouts.
books: JSME Textbook Series, Introduction to Mechanical Engineers, The Japan Society of Mechanical Engineers, (2012) (in Japanese).
requiredKnowledge: Selecting and finding of an area of interest in mechanical engineering.

activityGoals.body: Be able to identify personal-advantages as well as consider the methods to improve them.
Be able to clearly explain own goals to be achieved in department of mechanical engineering.
Be able to explain the relationship between academic area and leading edge research projects.
Be able to explain the role of mechanical engineer in industries and student's own career development process.
